rationale: US rate hike will tighten EU-wide borrowing costs affecting Portuguese economy and government debt; Panama Canal drought worsens with further traffic cuts threatening Atlantic shipping.

top_events.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
top_events.label: US Fed raises rates against Trump wishes
top_events.summary: Federal Reserve hiked rates unanimously despite Trump opposition. This tightens global financial conditions, raising borrowing costs for Portugal and pressuring EU peripheral economies.

top_events.title: Panama canal traffic facing further cuts as drought from El Niño worsens
top_events.label: Panama Canal cuts traffic as drought worsens
top_events.summary: El Niño drought forces additional reductions in canal traffic, further choking a critical global shipping lane. Affects Atlantic maritime routes and Portuguese import/export costs.

top_events.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
top_events.label: EU chief supports Canada associate membership
top_events.summary: Canada seeks closer EU ties after US relations breakdown. Could benefit Portuguese trade and strengthen transatlantic economic cooperation, though details remain vague.
